mapper.sql: d.f_ID AS f_ID, d.f_Code AS f_Code, d.f_Name AS f_Name, d.fk_Reported_Org_Name AS fk_Reported_Org_Name, d.f_Incident_Date AS f_Incident_Date, d.f_Settle_Method AS f_Settle_Method, if(d.f_Status IN (1, 7, 8), 1, 0) AS is_closed, d.f_Is_External AS f_Is_External, d.f_Is_Major AS f_Is_Major, d.f_Type AS f_Type, d.f_Type_2 AS f_Type_2, d.f_Type_3 AS f_Type_3, d.f_Description AS f_Description, d.f_Status AS f_Status, progress.f_Cause AS f_Cause, d.f_Related_Amount AS f_Related_Amount, ourside.ourside_Name AS ourside, opposite.opposite_Name AS opposite, cnt.relationCount AS relationCount, cnt.caseCodeCount AS caseCodeCount
SELECT our.fk_Dispute_ID AS fk_Dispute_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(our.f_Litigant_Name SEPARATOR ', ') AS ourside_Name FROM fw_litigate_dispute_ourside our WHERE our.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY our.fk_Dispute_ID
SELECT oppo.fk_Dispute_ID AS fk_Dispute_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(oppo.f_Name SEPARATOR ', ') AS opposite_Name FROM fw_litigate_dispute_opposite oppo WHERE oppo.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY oppo.fk_Dispute_ID

SELECT prog.fk_Dispute_ID AS fk_Dispute_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(',', f_Cause_1, f_Cause_2, f_Cause_3, f_Cause_4) SEPARATOR ',') AS f_Cause FROM fw_litigate_dispute_progress AS prog WHERE prog.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY prog.fk_Dispute_ID

SELECT rel.fk_Dispute_ID AS fk_Dispute_ID, COUNT(1) AS relationCount, COUNT(IF(( SELECT IF(relDispute.f_Case_Code IS NULL OR relDispute.f_Case_Code = '', NULL, relDispute.f_Case_Code) FROM fw_litigate_dispute AS relDispute WHERE relDispute.f_ID = rel.fk_Related_ID AND relDispute.f_IsDel = 0 ) IS NULL, NULL, 1)) AS caseCodeCount FROM fw_litigate_dispute_relation AS rel WHERE rel.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY rel.fk_Dispute_ID
